### A2770 (2026-2027)

- **Policy ID:** `nj-a2770-2026-2027`
- **Sponsor / party:** Asw. Andrea Katz; D
- **Status:** Introduced 2026-01-13, referred to Assembly Telecommunications and Utilities Committee; no further Assembly action listed in official history captured 2026-11-05.
- **Provisions:** Establishes a surcharge on electric public utility service to certain data centers during certain periods and creates a "Grid Modernization Fund" within BPU; a direct ratepayer-cost-allocation measure. Reintroduction of 2024-2025 session's A6040, which did not advance.
- **Mechanism / scope:** other; utility_grid
- **Legal effect:** proposed
- **Effective date:** —
- **End condition and limitations:** —

- **Policy ID:** `nj-a2774-s4304-2026-2027`
- **Sponsor / party:** Asw. Andrea Katz / (Senate companion S4304); D
- **Status:** A2774 remains at its 2026-01-13 Assembly Science, Innovation and Technology referral. ### A3966 (2026-2027)

- **Policy ID:** `nj-a3966-2026-2027`
- **Sponsor / party:** Asm. Robert J. Karabinchak; D
- **Status:** A3966 passed the Assembly 76-0-1 on 2026-10-29 after an October 22 committee report/second reading; its March 16 committee amendments produced the first reprint. The official description lists S4400 as identical; separate S4400 history shows October 8 second reading and referral to Senate Budget and Appropriations. API histories observed 2026-11-09; no enactment established.
- **Provisions:** First reprint proposes a DEP evaluation within one year after an enacted effective date of large-scale data-center water use, covering drinking-water systems, wastewater systems and the environment. DEP, consulting BPU, would establish coverage thresholds using water use, electric demand, size, cooling/computing capacity or other resource factors; the print sets no fixed MW cutoff. The study covers preceding three- and seven-year effects, permits specified data requests and estimates, and requires a report within 15 months after an enacted effective date. These are proposed duties.
- **Mechanism / scope:** other; state_agency
- **Legal effect:** proposed
- **Effective date:** —
- **End condition and limitations:** If enacted in the first-reprint form, the act would expire upon submission of the DEP report to the Governor and Legislature; enactment is not established.
- **Primary reference:** [Official source](<https://www.njleg.state.nj.us/bill-search/2026/A3966>)

### A5462 (2024-2025)

- **Policy ID:** `nj-a5462-2024-2025`
- **Sponsor / party:** Asm. David Bailey Jr.; D
- **Status:** Passed both houses 2026-01-12; pocket veto (bill not acted on by Governor before end of 221st Legislature) 2026-01-20
- **Provisions:** Pocket-vetoed second reprint proposed utility tariffs for centralized commercial facilities with aggregate monthly demand over 100 MW, aggregable by ownership, control and infrastructure. Its final definition replaced the earlier data-center-specific language. These failed-bill terms are not current tariff requirements.

### S680 / A1170 (2026-2027)

- **Policy ID:** `nj-s680-a1170-2026-2027`
- **Sponsor / party:** Sen. Bob Smith; Sen. John F. McKeon / Asm. Joe Danielsen; D
- **Status:** Retained histories show S680 reported and referred to Senate Budget and Appropriations on 2026-03-16, and A1170 introduced/referred on 2026-01-13. These are separate chamber histories; later action is not established by this review.
- **Provisions:** The introduced S680 text covers AI data centers and cryptocurrency mining facilities; the reviewed introduced A1170 text covers AI data centers. In both reviewed texts, a published BPU finding that most PJM states implement specified supply and no-net-decrease requirements triggers the energy plan submitted with the local application and supply from new verifiable Class I renewables and/or newly constructed nuclear plants, measured hourly and without net decrease of those sources on the system. Section 3(d) separately bars grid connection without approval of a section 3(b) plan; the pre-finding interaction is unresolved. BPU decision: 90 days; resubmission after disapproval: 30 days. No finding, implementation, later-version equality or enactment established.
- **Mechanism / scope:** other; utility_grid
- **Legal effect:** proposed
- **Effective date:** —
- **End condition and limitations:** —
- **Primary reference:** [Official source](<https://www.njleg.state.nj.us/bill-search/2026/S680>)
